extension.summary: Album-art colours for skins and Shadertoy visualisations.
extension.description: While music plays, this service takes four colours from the album cover (dominant, second, accent and shadow). Skins can read them as Window(Home).Property(VizPalette.Color1) to VizPalette.Color4. If a Shadertoy preset pack is installed, it also writes the colours and a small copy of the cover into the pack folder, so the visualisation takes on the album's colours. It does nothing for video or while idle.
extension.news: 1.1.3 - Dark covers no longer give black colours: on an album with a black background, Color2 and Color4 used to be FF000001. Every colour is now a usable shade, the four are always different, and the shadow (Color4) is a darker shade of the main colour. 1.1.2 - The Shadertoy pack folder setting is empty by default; the pack is found automatically in Shadertoy's add-on data. 1.1.1 - The shadow colour (VizPalette.Color4) is always a darker shade: on pale covers it used to repeat the main colour. 1.1.0 - Publishes the palette as Window(Home).Property(VizPalette.Color1..4) whether or not a Shadertoy pack is installed. The pack folder is now a setting. Licensed GPL-2.0-or-later.
